items.title: Wayne Andre interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 7, 2002
items.q: I had a teacher in Hartford, Connecticut who had been in Gene Krupa’s band, Bill Cully

ctx.x: Had you decided at a fairly early age that music was going to be your career?

Yes I did as a matter of fact. I can start at the beginning if you want. I don’t want to get too lengthy with this. I can get lengthy but, I came home from public school I think in the fourth or fifth grade and they had passed out this piece of paper about taking an instrument and a group thing and everything else. I said to my dad I says, “Oh I think maybe I’d like to do the trumpet or the drums.” Something like that. I can’t remember — I think I’m sure I showed enthusiasm, but my father loved music so if I…
What kind of music was played in your house when you were a kid?
